headline: Colonials Rebound in Nevish Line and Callahan's Passage Amid Fierce Clashes
war_summary: Colonial arms have struck back sharply across the western and central sectors since the last dispatch, deadlocking Nevish Line at four garrisons apiece following thirteen frantic base transfers and a surge of over thirteen hundred combined casualties in two hours. Callahan’s Passage remains a bloodbath of high attrition, where Colonial forces recaptured two strongpoints around Crumbling Post and The Crumbling Passage to leave the sector standing eight bases to two in Warden hands. In Weathered Expanse, Colonial advances secured an eighth garrison against a single Warden holdout amid punishing artillery fire that took over twelve hundred lives across the two-hour mark. Palantine Berm recorded five rapid base exchanges centered on Leiri Hermanni and The Pippeli Stones, though Warden defenders ultimately preserved their clean sweep of all seven bastions as casualty rates sharply subsided. Further east, Stlican Shelf resolved its neutral ground into a seven-to-two Colonial advantage, while fighting in Stonecradle reduced Trammel Pool to an unclaimed ruin. Across these shifting fronts, intense pressure continues to test fortified perimeters from coast to coast.
